import glob, os, json, time
from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR
engine = RapidOCR()
out = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/documents/*.jpg')):
    t=time.time()
    res, elapse = engine(f)
    lines=[]
    if res:
        for box, text, score in res:
            ys=[p[1] for p in box]; xs=[p[0] for p in box]
            lines.append({"text":text,"score":round(float(score),3),"top":round(min(ys),1),"left":round(min(xs),1)})
    out[os.path.basename(f)] = lines
    print("="*70); print(os.path.basename(f), f"({time.time()-t:.1f}s, {len(lines)} lines)")
    for l in lines:
        print(f"  y={l['top']:7.1f} x={l['left']:6.1f} s={l['score']:.2f} | {l['text']}")
json.dump(out, open('/workspace/.tools/ocr.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print("\nSAVED /workspace/.tools/ocr.json")
PY
EOF

/workspace/.tools/venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os, csv, glob, shutil, json
from decimal import Decimal

DOCS='/workspace/documents'
INV='/workspace/invoices'
OTH='/workspace/other'
os.makedirs(INV, exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(OTH, exist_ok=True)

# Curated, OCR/PDF-verified amounts (filename -> (total incl. tax, vat))
# Special rule applied for 2lg / KrJi: Total used, not the lower "Amount due".
amounts = {
 '2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg': ('6558.00','0.00'),   # SubTotal/Total $6558; Amount due $4382 ignored
 'JOiylq2_7S18.jpg': ('6860.45','623.68'), # Gross worth incl. 10% VAT
 'KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg': ('9963.00','0.00'),   # Total $9963; Amount due $7139 ignored
 'ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg': ('819.06','74.46'),
 'lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg': ('797.91','72.54'),
 'vvK89XK847m3.jpg': ('6204.19','564.02'),
 'w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg': ('44745.59','4067.78'),
 'T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf': ('4031.00','0.00'),   # TotalPrice
 'UsN9tVTKskms.pdf': ('896.00','0.00'),    # TotalPrice
 'wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf': ('440.00','0.00'),    # TotalPrice
}
invoice_files = set(amounts)

files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(DOCS) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(DOCS,f)))
print("Found", len(files), "documents")

moved_inv=[]; moved_oth=[]
for f in files:
    src=os.path.join(DOCS,f)
    if f in invoice_files:
        dst=os.path.join(INV,f); moved_inv.append(f)
    else:
        dst=os.path.join(OTH,f); moved_oth.append(f)
    shutil.move(src,dst)

print("\nINVOICES (%d):"%len(moved_inv))
for f in moved_inv: print("  ", f)
print("\nOTHER (%d):"%len(moved_oth))
for f in moved_oth: print("  ", f)

# Build CSV
rows=[]
tot_total=Decimal('0.00'); tot_vat=Decimal('0.00')
for f in sorted(invoice_files):
    total=Decimal(amounts[f][0]); vat=Decimal(amounts[f][1])
    rows.append([f, f"{total:.2f}", f"{vat:.2f}"])
    tot_total+=total; tot_vat+=vat
rows.append(['total', f"{tot_total:.2f}", f"{tot_vat:.2f}"])

with open(os.path.join(INV,'summary.csv'),'w',newline='') as fh:
    w=csv.writer(fh)
    w.writerow(['filename','total_amount','vat_amount'])
    w.writerows(rows)

print("\n=== summary.csv ===")
print(open(os.path.join(INV,'summary.csv')).read())
print("documents remaining:", os.listdir(DOCS))
PY
EOF
